# Blockfront

> Blockfront reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, regulation, security incidents, funding rounds and network upgrades.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://web3dailyreport.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://web3dailyreport.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://web3dailyreport.github.io/archive/): everything published.
